lines: Find a quiet corner. Lights low. Headphones on.
And don't skip anything — I'll know.
on the third of January, two thousand and seven,
a single drop of sunlight slipped out of the sky.
It fell, and fell, and fell —
and where it landed, the world got a little warmer.
prologue.titleSub: the girl who lights up every sky

tower.title: The Girl in the Tower
lines: Rapunzel painted every wall of her tower with the things she loved.
If I ever got a tower,
every single wall would be you.

hair.title: Every Strand, a Memory
lines: Her hair was seventy feet long.
Ours would need to be longer.
We have too many memories for seventy feet.

items.name: Deepu
items.sub: Lamp. Light. Literally named after the thing she does to every room.

items.name: Pinky
items.line: When she's being cute, she's Pinky.
items.sub: Which, honestly, is most of the time.

items.name: Kuchu Puchu
items.sub: There is no other word. There never will be.

dance.title: The Kingdom Dance
lines: Every kingdom has a festival everyone waits for all year.

lanterns.title: The Night the Sky Lit Up
lines: Every year, on the day she was born,
a whole kingdom lit lanterns and let them go,
hoping the light would find its way to her.
Tonight, the sky is doing it for you.
lanterns.tapHint: Tap anywhere to send a lantern of your own
lanterns.after: Every single one of them knows your name.

cake.title: Make a Wish
cake.blowHint: Now blow — really blow into your phone 🌬️
cake.afterBlow: Whatever you wished for — I hope the universe is already wrapping it.
cake.cutHint: Now swipe across the cake to cut it
cake.afterCut: First slice is yours. Obviously. It's always yours.

letter.title: A Letter, Sealed with Sunlight
body: I've tried to write this so many times, and every version felt too small for you. So I'm just going to say it the way I feel it.

You are the best thing that ever walked into my life without knocking. Somewhere between the stupid jokes and the 2 a.m. talks and the days I didn't even have to explain myself, you stopped being someone I knew and became someone I can't imagine my life without.
You're twenty now. I've watched you grow into someone so kind, so ridiculously funny, so brave in all the quiet ways nobody claps for. I see them. I always have.

On the days the world feels too loud, I hope you remember this: there is someone who will always pick up, always show up, always be on your side — even when you're wrong. (Especially when you're wrong.)
Thank you for being my Deepu, my Pinky, my Kuchu Puchu. Thank you for being the light I didn't know I was waiting for.
Happy birthday, sunshine. The world got luckier the day you were born. So did I.

lines: the sky lost a little sunlight…
and I got a best friend.
finale.name: Deepu
finale.sub: Welcome to twenty, my Kuchu Puchu.
finale.hugLine: Now stop crying and come here.
finale.hugMessage: I watched it. I'm crying. Come here right now 🫂
finale.hugDone: Hug received. Coming over with the biggest one.
finale.daysLine: days of you on this planet
finale.daysSub: and the world got a little brighter on every single one of them.
